verdict.rationale: Capacities offers AI chat with note context, natural-language querying/search, and AI actions that can 'propose creates and updates for you to approve,' plus MCP/API integration for building custom agents — showing meaningful natural-language command capability. However, this is chat/assistant-driven rather than a full agentic command interface across all app actions, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of natural-language command execution. Missing for 10: independent verification of NL command breadth and reliability, evidence of natural-language control over non-AI-chat app functions (e.g., navigation, settings) rather than just content Q&A/auto-fill.
